mutations.name: MS1 Monetisation is dropped from the funnel
mutations.pattern: names six stages in funnel order

mutations.name: MS2 TikTok Monetisation binds earnings TikTok does not report
MS3 Facebook Monetisation divides by views Facebook does not have
mutations.pattern: binds Facebook to its ad-break earnings

mutations.name: MS4 A reconnect is offered where a vendor review stands first
mutations.pattern: offers a reconnect only where reconnecting would grant something

mutations.name: MS5 A creator outside the Partner Program is told it is ours
mutations.pattern: says the platform’s, the creator’s and ours apart

mutations.name: MS6 No measured revenue reads as $0 in the totals
mutations.find:
// Not measured, not $0: the identity a measured chunk replaces (FILM-1726).
  revenue_cents: null,
mutations.replace:
// Not measured, not $0: the identity a measured chunk replaces (FILM-1726).
  revenue_cents: 0,
mutations.pattern: should return zeros when no data

mutations.name: MS7 The revenue card shows $0 for not measured
MS8 A report totals unmeasured revenue as $0
mutations.pattern: totals earnings over the rows that measured them

mutations.name: MS9 The report CSV writes 0.00 for unmeasured revenue
MS10 An unauthorised YouTube read writes revenue rows
mutations.pattern: writes nothing unless the read was authorised

mutations.name: MS11 YouTube revenue is asked for as one total, not by day
mutations.pattern: fetches revenue in its own query

mutations.name: MS12 A Page that may not read earnings reads as a retry
mutations.pattern: reads a permission refusal as the Page

mutations.name: MS13 The project revenue read includes rows marked not measured
mutations.pattern: reads publish-scoped rows through the project chain

mutations.name: MS14 TikTok's hardcoded zero is read as measured revenue
mutations.replace:
revenue_cents: 0, // TikTok doesn't expose revenue
        ad_revenue_cents: 0,
        red_revenue_cents: 0,
        revenue_measured: true,
mutations.pattern: is false for TikTok and Instagram

mutations.name: MS17 The not-measured reasons show beside a measured figure
mutations.pattern: keeps the reasons off a measured figure

mutations.name: MS18 A channel nothing stands in the way of is given a reason
mutations.pattern: says nothing for a channel nothing stands in the way of

mutations.name: MS19 Monetisation counts toward the pattern minimum again
mutations.pattern: never counts Monetisation toward the minimum

mutations.name: MS20 coverage stops reading video_revenue_daily
mutations.pattern: YouTube revenue is observed in video_revenue_daily

mutations.name: DB MS15 A person's entry may have no amount
mutations.sql: alter table public.revenue_records drop constraint revenue_records_manual_has_amount;

mutations.name: DB MS16 The per-publish sum returns a currency nothing measured
mutations.sql: create or replace function public.revenue_cents_by_publish(p_publish_ids uuid[]) returns table (publish_id uuid, currency text, cents bigint) language sql stable security invoker set search_path = '' as $$ select r.publish_id, r.currency::text, sum(r.revenue_cents)::bigint from public.revenue_records r where r.publish_id = any(p_publish_ids) group by r.publish_id, r.currency::text $$;
